jobPostingInfo.title: Asset Management Lead
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Job Description

The Asset Management Lead is responsible for the management, maintenance, calibration, and operational readiness of the Company's survey and geotechnical equipment fleet. The role provides technical leadership for workshop operations, asset integrity, equipment mobilization and demobilization, inventory control, and maintenance planning, ensuring equipment is available, compliant, and fit for purpose to support safe and efficient project delivery. Key contacts include Operations, Project Delivery, Technical, Commercial, and HSE teams. Supervises workshop personnel and assigned technical staff.
